text:
Which word equation represents a reaction that occurs with ethanoic acid?
ethanoic acid  +  calcium carbonate  →  salt  +  carbon dioxide
A
ethanoic acid  +  copper  →  salt  +  hydrogen
B
ethanoic acid  +  magnesium  →  salt  +  hydrogen
C
ethanoic acid  +  sodium hydroxide  →  salt  +  oxygen
D

options.label: A
options.text: ethanoic acid  +  calcium carbonate  →  salt  +  carbon dioxide

options.label: D
options.text: ethanoic acid  +  sodium hydroxide  →  salt  +  oxygen
